title: Automated Survey Data Pipeline
text:
The problem
Survey data took 3–4 weeks to go from survey close to usable results, and preparing each survey took about 3 days of manual work.

title: Automated Survey Data Pipeline
text:

Standardized survey data processing with dbt/SQL pipelines in Snowflake
Gold-level data models that feed Power BI dashboards on audience engagement, revenue KPIs, and demographics
A site-by-content-index heatmap in Power BI, with a DAX measure (using REMOVEFILTERS) that calculates the percentage of known users independent of demographic filters
Data governance: access controls and data quality checks across the pipelines and dashboards
